description: This file defines the CustomizedGlobalEventRegistry class, which extends AbstractJsonParsableRegistry and implements EventRegistry. It manages parsing strategies for events by merging global registry types with custom strategies, facilitating flexible event handling within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: CustomizedGlobalEventRegistry
classes.description: A registry class that manages event parsing strategies by combining global and custom strategies for the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: mergeParseStrategy
methods.description: Combines parse strategies from the global event registry with custom strategies into a single map.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the type of an event from a JsonObject by delegating to the global event registry.
